# ft_vox_headless canonical scripted fixture (issue #210, Epic #204 Phase F;
# gameplay loop issue #230, Epic #223 Phase G).
#
# Deterministic by construction: fixed seed (--seed 42), fixed host dt
# (1/60), fixed per-frame streaming budgets, synchronous generation by
# default. Run it twice and compare the SUMMARY digest:
#
#   ft_vox_headless --seed 42 --ticks 600 --script tests/fixtures/sim-actions.txt
#
# Edits target y=220: guaranteed air above any generated terrain. The
# gameplay leg hovers the (flight-mode) player just above that plateau, so
# the player-aware placement rule never refuses the scripted cells.
# Block/item names are single tokens (underscores, case-insensitive).

# --- locomotion legs (world-XZ movement, sprint, jump) ---------------------
wait 30
move 1 0
wait 60
sprint on
move 0 1
wait 60
jump
wait 30
sprint off
move -1 0
wait 60
move 0 -1
wait 60

# --- authoritative local edits (cell coordinates) --------------------------
place 8 220 8 Stone
place 9 220 8 Dirt
place 10 220 8 Glass
expect voxel 8 220 8 Stone
expect voxel 9 220 8 Dirt
expect voxel 10 220 8 Glass
delete 9 220 8
expect voxel 9 220 8 air

# --- settle, then re-verify the surviving edits -----------------------------
wait 120
expect voxel 8 220 8 Stone
expect voxel 10 220 8 Glass
expect voxel 9 220 8 air

# --- gameplay loop (issue #230): break -> wait -> pickup -> placeSelected ---
# Flight is host-driven: the teleport position holds exactly (no drift), so
# the break drop spawns within pickup radius of the hovering player feet.
flight on
move 0 0
teleport 8.5 221.5 8.5
wait 30
give Stone 5
expect inventory 0 Stone 5
select 0
break 8 220 8              # gameplay break: Stone -> Cobblestone drop
expect items 1
wait 90                    # pickup delay + proximity auto-pickup (tick rule)
expect items 0
expect inventory 1 Cobblestone 1   # hotbar-first: slot 0 holds the Stone
select 1
placeSelected 11 220 8     # gameplay place-from-hotbar: consumes exactly 1
expect voxel 11 220 8 Cobblestone
expect inventory 1 empty 0
select 0
drop 2                     # manual drop, fixed +Z direction; long pickup delay
expect items 1
expect inventory 0 Stone 3

# Total scripted frames: 540. With --ticks 600 the runner idle-fills the
# remaining 60 frames (deterministic end condition). The manual drop is still
# IN FLIGHT at the digest boundary: item physics is digest-covered, and the
# sync/async parity check runs with a live entity. Final state: edits=6
# (3 places + 1 delete + 1 break + 1 placeSelected), items=1, inventory=3,
# item_high_water=2 (break drop id 1 picked up, manual drop id 2 alive).
